name: agent-sync
description: Let concurrent coding agents share one project without colliding — leases, ID reservation, a run journal and a generated board, over a pluggable knowledge cloud.

plugins.name: agent-sync
plugins.description: Coordination layer for multi-agent repositories. Gives task-pipeline runs a lease authority with TTL, race-free ID reservation, a cross-repo signal feed, an append-only run journal and a machine-generated read-only board, all decided by replaying one append-only log so no backend needs compare-and-swap. The knowledge backend is a pluggable adapter (Outline, filesystem) declaring its own capabilities, and degrades honestly to git-file leases when it cannot be the lease authority. Ships Claude Code hooks that deny edits to guarded registry files without a live lease.
